rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for cruel and unjust absolute rule.

example.english: Many people throughout history have suffered under tyranny.
example.traditional: 歷史上好多人民都曾經飽受暴政之苦。
example.jyutping: lik6 si2 soeng6 hou2 do1 jan4 man4 dou1 cang4 ging1 baau2 sau6 bou6 zing3 zi1 fu2

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress one ruler's unchecked power, even when cruelty is not the main focus.

example.english: That country has long been under the tyranny of one leader, with no one able to check his power.
example.traditional: 呢個國家長期由一個領袖實行獨裁統治，冇人可以制衡佢。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gwok3 gaa1 coeng4 kei4 jau4 jat1 go3 ling5 zau6 sat6 hang4 duk6 coi4 tung2 zi6 mou5 jan4 ho2 ji5 zai3 hang4 keoi5
